validity.recommendation: Existence, classification and non-duplicate status all confirmed independently; no action needed beyond refreshing the two dead Fuel/PipelineType refs below.
validity.researcher_notes: P4072 is a real, physically distinct project: a ~22-25 km 'looping' (second parallel line) built on the high-mountain (Kamchik-pass) section of the original 165 km Ahangaran-Pungan trunk (P4071, built 2009), to add capacity/reliability for Fergana Valley gas supply. Authorized by Presidential Decree PP-4563 (09.01.2020), item 12: 'Stroitel'stvo lupinga k magistral'nomu gazoprovodu «Akhangaran-Pungan»', Tashkent+Namangan oblasts, budgeted 2020-2022, implementer JSC Uztransgaz (lex.uz, government primary source). Construction start (25 km, high-mountain section) reported 15 Aug 2020 by EDC/Epsilon (kun.uz, uzreport.news - same press-release origin) and progress-confirmed ongoing Dec 2020 (Epsilon FB post, 20/25 km laid). A second, independently-sourced Ministry of Energy press item (Sept 6 2025; uzdaily.uz, spot.uz, podrobno.uz - three outlets off one Minenergy release) reports an ~22 km 'additional section' on this same Ahangaran-Pungan mountain corridor being connected/commissioned, closely matching a WebSearch snippet describing the looping as built in two phases (2020-2022, 2022-2025) - i.e. this is very likely the actual completion of THIS project, 5 years after construction start (see status_reviews). Classification 'magistral'nyy gazoprovod' (trunk/main gas pipeline) is used verbatim in both the 2020 and 2025 sourcing, confirming PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas. Checked against all 17 other in-scope Uzbekistan gas PIDs (incl. sibling P4071, P4073) for name/geometry/owner collision - none found; this is not a duplicate of P4071 (different length, different construction era, explicitly described as a 'luping k' [looping alongside] the existing trunk, not a re-description of it).
